_comment: Matches BOTH subject forms GitHub may send. The plain form is repo:owner/repo:ref:...; newer tokens carry immutable numeric IDs appended (repo:owner@OWNERID/repo@REPOID:ref:...), and a policy written for only one of them is denied with 'Not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity' and nothing explaining why. StringLike matches if ANY listed value matches, so listing both is correct rather than lax. The owner id (168718510 = hxb427) is pinned because it is immutable and is what stops another account's same-named repo matching; only the repo id is wildcarded, since it cannot be read without an authenticated API call and the owner+name pair already identifies the repo. Confirm the real subject in CloudTrail > Event history > AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity > userIdentity.userName if the assume ever fails.
